name: Ha Long to Cat Ba
summary: Take the car ferry from Tuan Chau to Gia Luan on the north tip of Cat Ba, about an hour, then a bus or taxi across the island to town. There are fewer sailings in the low season, so check the day’s departures before you go.

modes.note: Wikivoyage (updated February 2023) gives around one hour, with five sailings a day from 25 April to 5 September and three in the low season. Those clocks are dated, so check on arrival. The ferry takes motorbikes and cars. Gia Luận is about 20 km from Cát Bà town through the national park (Hải Phòng portal). A bus meets the ferry.
The Quảng Ninh portal (9 June 2024) describes a shortcut of about 7 km across the water to Cát Bà, with fast boats leaving Tuần Châu. It prints no minute.
Wikivoyage says combined boat-and-bus tickets between Cát Bà town and Hạ Long are sold on the waterfront square by the pier. Clock and fare are Check on arrival.

seoTitle: Ha Long to Cat Ba — Tuan Chau ferry, fast boat, or bus and boat
seoDescription: How to cross from Ha Long to Cat Ba: the Tuan Chau–Gia Luan car ferry, fast boats, and the road across the island to town.

faqs.q: How do I get back from Cat Ba to Ha Long?
faqs.a: Take the ferry from Gia Luận to Tuần Châu. Wikivoyage says the bus from town leaves about an hour before the ferry. No city bus runs from Tuần Châu into Hạ Long, so take a taxi or Grab.

faqs.q: Can I take a motorbike across?
faqs.a: Yes. The Tuần Châu – Gia Luận ferry carries motorbikes and cars.
